tolerance_rationale: Dasha start JD = jd - (rem/13.333)*period*year_duration. With Rahu's 18y period this amplifies Moon-longitude differences by ~493 days/degree, so the ~0.2 arcsec ephemeris drift (Python FLG_SWIEPH/JPL vs TS FLG_MOSEPH/Moshier) yields ~0.03 day start-date offset. Lord (discrete) matches exactly. 0.05 day bound.
